description: I’m a CSE undergraduate passionate about AI/ML, physics, space science, and quantum computing. I work with Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow and webdev. I want to turn NASA data into impactful, interactive solutions. I’m looking for collaborative teammates skilled in UI/UX, GIS/satellite data, astronomy, data science, or full-stack development. Curiosity, creativity, and teamwork matter most. Let’s build something meaningful!
